Subject: Fintegrate steering committee — exec sponsor & agenda

Hi Rachel —

Thanks again for taking time earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock the steering committee with your exec sponsor: 

Recap from today's call:
- Use case: customer support automation + knowledge retrieval for legacy policy docs
- Primary technical scope: embeddings + retrieval + private VPC deployment for PII controls
- Initial pilot success metric: 25% reduction in avg handle time + 95% relevance on top-3 responses

Stakeholder mapping (as we understand it):
- Economic buyer: Mark Holloway (CFO) — cost/ROI sign-off
- Exec sponsor: Mark Holloway or Head of Product (you indicated Mark would likely be the exec sponsor)
- Security / Legal / Procurement: procurement to run standard SOW + security questionnaire (need contact)

Requested next steps:
1) Can you confirm who will be the exec sponsor (name & preferred contact) and if Mark is available the week of Dec 14 or Dec 21?
2) Please share the procurement contact for SOW and the security reviewer so we can surface SOC2 summary and architecture diagrams ahead of the steering committee.
3) Attached: Steering_Deck_v2.pdf (deck for exec summary) and MAP_DRAFT.xlsx (mutual action plan draft). We can iterate on these once we know attendee list.

Proposed objective for steering committee: align on success metrics, procurement timeline, and decision criteria so we can have an approved pilot order by end of Q1.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick 15-min follow-up if helpful.

Best,
Marissa
